# Lime Digital Institute

> Lime Digital Institute is a digital marketing and AI training institute behind Crystal Mall, Rajkot, Gujarat, India. It runs classroom and live online programs taught in Gujarati and English for college students, career switchers and business owners who want to get hired or grow their own business with digital marketing.

## About

- Agency-style training: students work on live client campaigns and simulations, not only theory.
- 60+ AI tools are taught inside the modules, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and n8n.
- Languages: Gujarati and English.
- Batches: Regular evening (6–7 PM), Fast Track, Weekend (Saturday 9 AM–1 PM) and Online.
- Audience: college students and graduates, working professionals switching careers, and business owners who want to market their own business.
- Founder: Paras Patel.

## Programs

- [Digital Marketing Foundation](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/courses): 1.5 months · ₹39,999 classroom / ₹29,999 online
- [Digital Marketing Professional](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/digital-marketing-professional): 3 months, 16 modules · ₹64,999 classroom / ₹54,999 online
- [Bachelor's in Digital Business](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/bachelors-in-digital-business): 3 years
- [Master's in Digital Business](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/masters-in-digital-business): 11 months
- Free 3-day demo class at the Rajkot campus: [book here](https://courses.limedigitalinstitute.org/)
- Core topics: performance marketing, Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO including technical SEO, generative AI for marketing, funnel and workflow automation, content strategy, analytics.

## Placements and outcomes

All figures are self-reported by the institute.
- Placement assistance is offered to every student of the career-track programs: resume, LinkedIn, portfolio, mock interviews and interview referrals.
- 93% of students placed within 60 days of completing the program.
- 800+ students placed.
- 50+ hiring partners.
- Rated 4.9/5 by students.
- Details: [Placements](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/placements), [Case studies](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/case-studies), [Student reviews](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/reviews), [Alumni](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/alumni)

## Blog

- [5 ChatGPT Prompts Every Marketer Should Know](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/blog/5-chatgpt-prompts-every-marketer-should-know): reusable prompt frameworks for ad copy, personas, content calendars, landing pages and reports
- [How to Read a Google Ads Dashboard Like a Pro](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/blog/how-to-read-a-google-ads-dashboard): which columns matter and a 15-minute weekly review routine
- [SEO vs Paid Ads: Where Should Beginners Start?](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/blog/seo-vs-paid-ads-where-should-beginners-start): speed, cost and a 90-day order for students and small businesses
- [Building a Resume Recruiters Actually Open](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/blog/building-a-resume-recruiters-actually-open): resume structure and portfolio tips for digital marketing jobs
- [Canva AI vs Midjourney: Which One Should You Learn First?](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/blog/canva-ai-vs-midjourney-which-to-learn-first): comparing two creative AI tools for marketing work
- [Automating Client Reports with n8n](https://limedigitalinstitute.org/blog/automating-client-reports-with-n8n): a beginner's walkthrough for weekly reports
